propositions: Plan-review PASS verdict does not sign and persist an attestation by default on all public entry points, leaving the ticket claim-invalid despite incurring full LLM cost.
Deliberate unsigned execution must be explicit and visible: CLI requires --no-sign flag, library requires sign=False parameter; omitting these must sign by default.
Non-signable verdicts (BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded results) must remain unsigned; idempotent reuse must not re-run LLM or duplicate signature when claim-valid attestation already exists.
Signing-persistence failure on PASS must return established retryable failure disposition and direct to sign-review recovery path rather than masking as success.
CLI parser, library contract, end-to-end lifecycle, and never-sign guard behavior must be tested and verified; documentation must pin sign-on-PASS default and explicit opt-out syntax.
